categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their ownership status (private or state), extent, and legal encumbrances. The content is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land settlement matters in specific geographic locations, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
